name: Matutinal-Codex
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around massive canyon systems, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on iron and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
